ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image is a food web, containing organisms such as Algae, Tiny Shrimps, Butterfly Fish, Limpets, Periwinkles, Snails, Crabs, Cuttlefish, etc. Crabs are located in the middle right side of the image, and Cuttlefish are located on the far right side. In the image there is an arrow pointing from Crabs to Cuttlefish. Reasoning: According to the convention in food webs that arrows point from food/prey to predators, Crabs are one of the food sources of Cuttlefish. If Crabs are removed, Cuttlefish will lose this food source, therefore their population size will decrease.
